meta.title: Products | Pink Blinds & Shutters
meta.description: Custom window treatments and window film — shutters, blinds, shades, drapery and screens, fabricated to fit and professionally installed.

hero.description: Every treatment we sell is custom fabricated, professionally installed, and available motorized — hardwired or battery-powered with remote control.

plantationShutters.intro1: Pink gives you ultimate control of light, temperature, noise and privacy, with the most durable & beautiful plantation shutters you can own. You can’t find more beautiful custom window treatments than our shutters… You’ll love the way they look in your home!
plantationShutters.block1: Our shutters are engineered to perform perfectly for life. They are easy to clean—just dust them like furniture or wipe smudges with a damp cloth. Our custom plantation shutters will look beautiful in your home, day after day. If you’re looking for an energy efficient shutter, look no further. The Polywood Shutter Insulating System has been built with energy conservation in mind. The shutters feature our exclusive weatherstripping on each stile (vertical section) to help block out more temperature and light than any other shutter. Polywood’s paint finish is UV coated for ultimate protection from the elements. In independent tests, Polywood was proven to be up to 70% more energy efficient than wood shutters and nearly 1600% more energy efficient than aluminum mini-blinds. Polywood shutters are more energy efficient than both wood and faux plantation shutters.
plantationShutters.block8: Polywood Shutters are the perfect addition to any outdoor living space. They are weatherproof, moisture, and rain resistant. Polywood shutters add value to your home, and allow for improved outdoor flexibility, and control.

biFoldShutters.intro1: Bi-fold Shutters are constructed of hinged panels that fold up to save space and open up your doorway, Bi-fold shutters can be installed to open all in the same direction or to open toward both sides of the sliding door.
biFoldShutters.intro2: Bi-fold Shutters are an especially good option if you want to have a full view since all the panels will conveniently fold to one side.

bypassTrackShutters.intro1: Bypass Track Shutters are a perfect option for your sliding glass doors! The Bypass Track Shutter System operates by allowing your shutter panels to slide past each other, via top tracks, to open and close.

slidingBarnDoorShutters.intro1: Are you looking for a unique and functional window treatment to complement any room in your home? Sliding Barn Door Shutters are an excellent conversation piece, and provide the option to let the sun shine through, or create absolute shade. Barn doors are one of the most sought after home décor items, and now Pink Blinds and Shutters is offering them to our customers.

horizontalWoodBlinds.intro1: Our hardwood blinds are made of the highest quality Basswood. We have 6 charming collections to choose from, each with its own style.

fauxWoodBlinds.intro1: Perfect in areas with high humidity, or as a lower-cost alternative to hardwood, our faux wood blinds are a great choice.

pinkluxeBlinds.intro1: As Pink Blinds & Shutters Interiors works to expand our services and product line, we are excited to announce that we now produce our very own exclusive line of PinkLuxe 2” or 2 ½” horizontal slatted, Wood and Faux Wood Blinds by Pink Blinds & Shutters Interiors
pinkluxeBlinds.block1: Our PinkLuxe horizontal Wood and Faux Wood Blinds are proudly made in the USA and come with a limited lifetime warranty on craftsmanship and installation .
pinkluxeBlinds.block2: Our very own exclusive line of PinkLuxe Wood and Faux Wood Blinds are fabricated immediately and are ready to ship out within five (5) business days.
pinkluxeBlinds.block3: PinkLuxe Fauxwood Blinds are available in the following features and design options:
pinkluxeBlinds.block8: resistant to humidity and temperature change; ideal for kitchens and bathrooms
pinkluxeBlinds.block9: Selection of 18+ colors and finishes, including wood tones and several shades of white
pinkluxeBlinds.block11: Decorative cloth tapes available (on 2” slat size blinds)
pinkluxeBlinds.block12: PinkLuxe Wood Blinds are available in the following features and design options:
pinkluxeBlinds.block17: Selection of 18+ colors and finishes, including wood tones and several shades of white
pinkluxeBlinds.block19: Decorative cloth tapes available (on 2” slat size blinds)

rollerShades.intro1: Our unique line of roller shades will change the way you think about roller shades.

solarShades.intro1: Solar shades cut glare and heat without giving up your view — a 10% openness blocks 90% of harmful ultraviolet light. They come in various colors and openness levels, and can be fabricated cordless or motorized.

flatRomanShades.intro1: Whether you’re looking for residential or commercial window treatments, draperies are adaptable to any size window in any room environment.

wovenWoodShades.intro1: Woven wood shades capture the beauty of the outdoors. Our woven woods take it a step farther with a unique line of reeds, grasses, bamboo, and natural fibers that create stunning masterpieces in the window.

honeycombShades.intro1: Honeycomb or cellular shades are known for their ability to protect against UV’s, insulate against cold and heat and diffuse light. They never fade and come in variety of colors and cell sizes.

sheerShadings.intro1: This elegant treatment represents a uniquely beautiful window covering.

panelTracks.intro1: For a contemporary window treatment on large windows or sliding doors, our panel tracks are the perfect answer. Panel tracks allow you to control light and privacy, and do it with the greatest style. They can also be used as room dividers in your home to give you added functionality in any room.

draperyAndCurtains.intro1: Whether you’re looking for residential or commercial window treatments, draperies are adaptable to any size window in any room environment.

retractableScreens.intro1: Retractable screens are the perfect solution for increasing airflow by allowing the cross ventilation of a cool breeze without allowing flies and other insects in. Additionally, our retractable screens for doors allow for increased ventilation while also eliminating the hassle of a permanent screen which can disrupt everyday use.
retractableScreens.block2: Customized to Fit ALL Door Types – Our retractable screens are cut to fit the exact size of your door, allowing them to fit ALL door types perfectly (including in-swing, out-swing, single, double and, sliding doors).
retractableScreens.block3: Protection – Retractable screens offer protection against insects from coming into your home.
retractableScreens.block4: Convenient and User-Friendly – Our retractable screens are there when you need them and tuck away discreetly when not in use.
retractableScreens.block5: Fresh Air – Bring fresh air into your home
retractableScreens.block6: Energy Savings – Screen doors save money on your utility bills during the hotter months of the year by reducing air conditioning use.

windowFilms.section1Text: Shatter Resistant Protection against Weather, Explosions, Wind, Vandalism.
windowFilms.section2Text: Increase Privacy, Enhance Aesthetics for Conference Rooms, Glass Partitions, Entry Doors & More.
windowFilms.section3Text: Protection from Fading due to UV Rays, Reduce Glare, Lower Energy Consumption, and Increased Privacy.
windowFilms.section4Text: If you are looking for Low E, Energy Savings, Reduce Glare, and to improve your comfort, we can make it happen.
windowFilms.section5Text: Add a touch of personality to your home with our gorgeous decorative glass. Watch your home light up with beautiful patterns and colors. Our decorative glass is hand selected by our team of highly educated interior designers so we can offer only the most current styles.
windowFilms.intro1: Window film adds privacy, security and style to glass you already own — without replacing it. We supply and install window films and decorative glass for homes, commercial spaces and government facilities.

meta.title: Motorization | Pink Blinds & Shutters
meta.description: Motorized shades and shutters — hardwired low voltage or rechargeable battery with remote — quieter mornings, safer windows, lower bills.

hero.description: Every treatment we install can be motorized — raised, lowered and tilted from a remote, a wall switch, or a schedule. No cords, no reaching, no ladders.

demo.title: You have the remote
demo.description: Press the buttons. This is the whole pitch — light when you want it, privacy when you don't, without leaving the couch.

power.title: Hardwired or battery — both installed by us
power.description: We fit the motor to your home, not the other way around. Both options run the same treatments and the same remotes.

hardwired.title: Hardwired low voltage
hardwired.description: Wired into your home's low-voltage system — no batteries to charge, ever. Motors run quieter and are always ready. The cleanest choice for new builds and renovations.

battery.title: Rechargeable battery + remote
battery.description: A rechargeable motor fits any existing window with no wiring and no opened walls, controlled from a handheld remote. A charge lasts months, and solar trickle-chargers mean you may never reach for a ladder.

benefits.title: More than a convenience
benefits.description: The quiet upgrades add up — every day, on every window.

safety.title: Safer for kids and pets
safety.description: No dangling cords means no strangulation hazard — the simplest way to make window treatments safer.

schedule.title: Set it and forget it
schedule.description: Program shades to wake with the sun and close at dusk — your windows keep the routine for you.

energy.title: Insulation on cue
energy.description: Shades that close against the afternoon sun ease the load on your HVAC and trim energy costs.

uv.title: Stop the fading
uv.description: Automatic closes during peak sun protect floors, rugs, upholstery and art from bleaching out.

reach.title: Hard-to-reach windows, handled
reach.description: Two-story foyers, stairwells and skylights operate from your hand instead of a ladder.

smart.title: App and voice control options
smart.description: Group rooms, set scenes, and integrate with smart-home platforms for app or voice control.

treatments.title: Motorize almost any treatment
treatments.description: From roller shades to drapery tracks — if we sell it, chances are we can motorize it.
